steps.message:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-04 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 133.9 | 19.46 | 19.46
2 | 50.7 | 19.69 | 39.15
3 | 23.0 | 4.00 | 43.15
4 | 61.9 | 4.32 | 47.47
5 | 20.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Reference note: Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

**Station:** H-04
**Curve type:** QHK (recalculated from resistivity sequence 133.9 > 50.7 > 23.0 < 61.9 > 20.8; note this corrects the file record, which lists QHA — the correct sequence of letters is Q-H-K, not Q-H-A)
**Aquifer depth:** 43.15 m – 47.47 m (Layer 4, the resistive unit sandwiched between the two conductive layers that defines the "K" segment of the curve)
**Recommendation:** Target drilling through the 43.15–47.47 m interval as the primary aquifer zone, as its elevated resistivity (61.9 Ω·m) relative to the bounding layers suggests saturated coarser-grained material; log carefully through the overlying low-resistivity Layer 3 (39.15–43.15 m), which likely acts as a clayey confining unit, and continue sampling into Layer 5 below 47.47 m to confirm whether its low resistivity (20.8 Ω·m) reflects a deeper clay unit or a secondary saline/fine-grained zone before finalizing well completion depth.
